summary: eXp World Holdings filed an 8-K announcing it acquired NextHome, Inc., a national real estate franchise, effective May 7, 2026. The acquisition integrates NextHome's franchise model with eXp's cloud-based brokerage, forming a multi-model platform for real estate professionals. No financial terms (price, premium, consideration) were disclosed. eXp also announced a ticker change from EXPI to AGNT, effective May 8, 2026. NextHome's management will continue leading the franchise. The filing lacks structural details or advisor names. Watch for future disclosures on purchase price, accretion, and integration progress; the deal signals a strategic pivot to a hybrid franchise/cloud model.
